source_passages.quotation: **Marquise setup (6.3):** Supply 25 warriors and 8 wood. Put keep in any corner (starting clearing). Put one warrior in every clearing except the diagonally opposite corner. Place one sawmill, workshop and recruiter among the keep clearing and adjacent clearings, in any combination respecting slots. Put the remaining five buildings of each type on their tracks from right to left, leaving leftmost space empty.

answer.ruling: The Marquise starts with 25 warriors and 8 wood. Put the Keep in any corner clearing; that is the starting clearing.
Put one warrior in every clearing except the corner diagonally opposite the Keep.

Place one sawmill, one workshop and one recruiter among the Keep clearing and its adjacent clearings, in any combination that respects building slots. Put the remaining five of each building type on its track from right to left, leaving the leftmost space empty.
